title: Approximate tangent planes of a set lying H^n-almost entirely in a C¹ submanifold are contained in its tangent spaces
statement: Let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ d-dimensional submanifold, M ⊆ ℝ^P with H^n(M ∖ N) = 0, and x ∈ N. If Q is an approximate tangent plane of M at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.4), then Q ⊆ T_xN (tangentSpace N x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (N M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N → x ∈ N → μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ tangentSpace N x
